name: Black Ram Exchange
label: Quest
description: Black Ram Exchange: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ye bring me yer old ram, I will trade it in for one from the new pack! The new ram will be just as fast as yer old one, but with a new look to him. You can look at the swift rams here to see what ye will have to choose from.
